content: I'm not paying the full deposit upfront – I'll only pay my share and expect the others to do the same.
I am conflicted: I really want to go but I cannot use my credit card, and I am not paid until the 28th.
I'm aware I need to decide about the trip and the £200 deposit, but I'm putting it off until I know more about my mum's care situation in October.
I'll check my bank account on Wednesday morning; if no deposit by then I'll contact the group.
I remember the deposit is £200 per household and I cannot use my credit card; I am paid on the 28th.
